title: Integrated communication: Public discourse — the invitation

frames.title: Lesson 102 · Integrated communication: Public discourse — the invitation

body: **Foco:** Comunicação integrada: Discurso público.
**Pronúncia:** Ritmo e ênfase para nuances.
**24 palavras novas** (discurso público).
**Texto do dia:** e-mail, carta, mensagem.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre convites e propostas de participação em eventos públicos a partir de um e-mail formal, com ritmo e ênfase adequados.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.subject: Invitation to deliver the closing address
paras: On behalf of the organizing committee, I am writing to **invite you** to deliver the **closing address** at the Civic Forum on 14 March. We should be **honoured** if you would speak for thirty minutes on **public trust**.

The session will be **livestreamed** and a **transcript** published. Should you **be unable to attend**, we would gladly **accommodate** a recorded message. Travel and lodging will be **covered in full**.
We would **be grateful for** your reply by 15 January, so that we may **finalise** the program.
With warm regards, Helena Cruz, Program Chair

items.q: The forum wants Dr. Alves to open the event.
The talk will be published as a transcript.
Dr. Alves may send a recording instead.

items.why: We would be grateful for your reply.

head: Função
Fórmula
Registro
rows: I am writing to **invite you** to…
We should be **honoured** if you would…
**Should you be unable to** attend, we would…
We would **be grateful for** your reply by…

blocks.body: No e-mail formal use **should** invertido em vez de *if*, **would** para suavizar e verbos de cortesia (**kindly, gladly**).
Evite *I want you to speak*: o tom é de ordem, não de convite.

items.s: I am writing to ___ you to deliver the address. (invite)
___ you be unable to attend, send a recording. (should)
We would be ___ for your reply. (grateful)
We would gladly ___ a recorded message. (accommodate)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **On behalf of…** — em nome de…
**We should be honoured if…** — ficaríamos honrados se…
**Kindly let us know** — por favor, informe-nos
**At your earliest convenience** — assim que lhe for conveniente
**Pending your reply** — à espera de sua resposta
**Look forward to hearing from you** — aguardar notícias suas
**Subject to availability** — sujeito à disponibilidade
**Rest assured** — pode ficar tranquilo
**Should the need arise** — se for necessário
**With the compliments of…** — com os cumprimentos de…
**We would be honoured if you could give the closing address.** — Ficaríamos honrados se a senhora fizesse o discurso de encerramento.
**Which date, and how long would I have?** — Em que data, e quanto tempo eu teria?
**I would be glad to come. Please send the program.** — Terei prazer em ir. Envie a programação, por favor.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.model: I am writing to invite you to speak at our forum.
I regret that I shall be unable to attend.

prompts.q: Ask for a reply by a date.
prompts.model: We would be grateful for your reply by Friday.

blocks.task: Write a formal email (6 sentences) inviting a speaker to a public lecture and offering an alternative if they cannot attend.
blocks.model: Dear Professor Reis, on behalf of the library board, I am writing to invite you to give the opening lecture on 9 May. We should be honoured if you would speak for forty minutes on civic memory. Should you be unable to attend, we would gladly accommodate a recorded address. Travel will be covered in full. We would be grateful for your reply by 1 April. With warm regards, Ana Costa.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
